scope: Current Onlystory real-content catalogs, prepared shared library and published standalone recipes. Excludes synthetic design fixtures and the separate legacy preview from totals.

definitions.collection: A named event, main-story chapter/volume, or group-story collection.
definitions.story: An individually readable chapter, section or scenario segment, not one passage.
definitions.readable: Published readable source exists in the shared library or a supported recipe. Does not imply installed in this browser or complete native-game presentation.
definitions.dialogue: Actual story text, excluding catalog titles and renderer fallback fields.
definitions.voice: Original spoken dialogue audio, kept separate from movie soundtracks, music and sound effects.

summary.localAvailability: The current development library contains every catalog-referenced asset; omitted native source/media gaps remain explicitly reported.
summary.standaloneAvailability: Pending on a fresh static/standalone install. GFL1 has no standalone acquisition recipe; an existing local library host is required.

countDefinitions.collection: Distinct collectionId in src/generated/gfl1-catalog.json, preserving native catalog ordering.
countDefinitions.story: One catalog entry, including main scenes, separate gameplay triggers, alternate endings, unplaced appendices and the one missing-source placeholder.
countDefinitions.readableStory: Catalog availability is available and import report has original source rows. Does not mean every optional original media effect is reproduced.
countDefinitions.passage: Compiler text/choice node count, report.textRows; source rows and command-only passages are counted separately.
countDefinitions.audioCue: Audio provenance records by native logical cue, which may share encoded audio files. No dialogue voices are imported.

countDefinitions: A story is one readable chapter/section, not a passage.
125 main stories are the six named main-story collections; 1,498 event stories are readable chapters in 182 named event collections.
128 further event-script metadata rows across 16 collections have no readable episode or download recipe and are excluded from 1,623 available stories.
Catalog title translation coverage is counted per available story.

summary.mediaCountDefinition: Unique payload SHA-256 values in published integrity manifests, not repeated references or URL aliases.

localizedTitles.source: JP catalog plus official global EN regional metadata

acquisition.local: All stories are in the current shared library.
acquisition.windows: All 1,659 stories have recipes that fetch and compile original files.
acquisition.browser: All 1,659 stories can be imported from user-selected original files. Official source CORS blocks direct browser fetching.
